purpose: Capability gap matrix for building a ChatGPT-like Aurora assistant. It records target behavior and acceptance evidence; it does not assert feature parity or implementation.

authority.registry_role: Architecture, integration, ownership and evidence control plane only
authority.security_boundary: Aurora is userspace/service infrastructure. Every privileged tool action requires policy evaluation and capability authorization; no ambient authority. Aurora does not own ShivaCore TCB, chain consensus, canonical ATC-VM, or governance decisions.

status_legend.SPECIFIED_NOT_IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFIED: A requirement/specification exists but implementation and runtime behavior are not verified.
status_legend.PLANNED_OR_NOT_VERIFIED: Source plan or component mapping exists; implementation not verified.
status_legend.CONTRACT_REQUIRED: Versioned interface contract is missing or incomplete.
status_legend.OPTIONAL_NOT_IN_CHAT_BASELINE: Not required for a useful first ChatGPT-like release; track separately.

target_features.name: Chat sessions and thread lifecycle
target_features.target_requirement: Create/list/resume/close isolated conversations; stable IDs and ownership; define retention and deletion.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: API contract tests for lifecycle, ownership isolation, restart recovery, and deletion.

target_features.name: Streaming model responses
target_features.target_requirement: Incremental token/event streaming with cancellation, timeout, disconnect handling, and terminal status.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Integration tests for ordered chunks, cancellation, timeout, partial failure, and resource cleanup.

target_features.name: Prompt and context assembly
target_features.target_requirement: Assemble system policy, user input, conversation history, retrieved context, and tool results under explicit token/resource limits.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Golden tests for precedence, truncation, injection boundaries, provenance, and deterministic error handling.

target_features.name: Model provider ABI and routing
target_features.target_requirement: Versioned provider-neutral request/response ABI including model identity, capabilities, streaming, cancellation, usage, errors, and fallback policy.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Conformance suite against mock and at least one real provider; fallback and timeout tests.

target_features.name: Conversation persistence and retrieval
target_features.target_requirement: Persist and retrieve authorized conversation records with tenant/user isolation, retention, export and deletion semantics.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Storage integration tests, access-control tests, migration tests, deletion verification.

target_features.name: Web search and research connector
target_features.target_requirement: Search only through explicitly authorized connectors; preserve source URL, retrieval time, and claim-to-source references.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Connector contract tests, hostile-content tests, citation provenance tests, network policy tests.

target_features.name: File upload and document parsing
target_features.target_requirement: Ingest supported files with size/type limits, parsing status, safe storage, access checks and user-visible errors.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Fixture tests for supported formats, malformed files, size limits, malware policy, and tenant isolation.

target_features.name: Tool registry and authorization
target_features.target_requirement: Tools declare schemas, capabilities, side effects, resource limits and approval requirements; deny by default.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Negative authorization tests, schema validation, approval tests, audit event assertions.

target_features.name: Code execution sandbox
target_features.target_requirement: Run code in an isolated, resource-limited environment with no ambient credentials or unrestricted network access.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Escape-resistance tests, CPU/memory/time limits, filesystem/network policy tests, cleanup tests.

target_features.name: Multi-step planning and task state
target_features.target_requirement: Represent plans, steps, dependencies, retries, checkpoints, cancellation and resumability as explicit task state.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: State-machine tests for retries, idempotency, cancellation, recovery and bounded loops.

target_features.name: Image input and vision
target_features.target_requirement: Accept images only through a declared model capability; enforce format/size limits and separate untrusted image content from instructions.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Vision-provider conformance tests, malformed input tests, prompt-injection and privacy tests.

target_features.name: Audio input/output and realtime voice
target_features.target_requirement: Define speech-to-text, text-to-speech and optional realtime streaming contracts, consent, cancellation and retention.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Audio fixture tests, latency/error/cancellation tests, consent and deletion tests.

target_features.name: Multimodal response output
target_features.target_requirement: Represent text and any generated media as typed outputs with provenance, safety metadata and storage policy.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Schema conformance tests and media access, provenance, and retention tests.

target_features.name: User, tenant and session isolation
target_features.target_requirement: Enforce identity-bound access across conversations, files, memory, tools and task results; no cross-tenant data leakage.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Cross-user/tenant negative test matrix and authorization audit.

target_features.name: Safety policy and refusal enforcement
target_features.target_requirement: Apply policy before protected tool actions and after model outputs where needed; separate model suggestions from authorization decisions.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Policy regression suite, bypass attempts, denied-action tests and auditable decisions.

target_features.name: Observability and audit trace
target_features.target_requirement: Correlate request, model call, retrieval, policy decision and tool execution without logging secrets or unnecessary personal data.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Trace completeness tests, redaction tests, correlation-ID propagation and audit integrity checks.

target_features.name: Evaluation and regression framework
target_features.target_requirement: Versioned eval datasets, task success metrics, safety/privacy suites and exact-SHA reports.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Reproducible evaluation run with pinned dataset/model/config and terminal logs.

target_features.name: Deployment, quotas, timeout and cancellation
target_features.target_requirement: Define concurrency limits, per-user quotas, deadlines, backpressure, graceful shutdown and failure isolation.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Load tests, quota tests, overload behavior, cancellation propagation and shutdown tests.

target_features.name: Source citations and provenance
target_features.target_requirement: Link externally grounded claims and retrieved memories to immutable provenance metadata; distinguish inference from sourced facts.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Citation resolution tests, stale-source tests, provenance completeness and unsupported-claim evals.

target_features.name: Model fine-tuning/training pipeline (optional)
target_features.target_requirement: Only required for custom model adaptation; define dataset lineage, consent/licensing, de-identification, evaluation, rollback and model artifact provenance.
target_features.acceptance_evidence_required: Dataset governance gates, reproducible training manifest, eval thresholds, artifact signing and rollback test.

release_gates: Every non-optional feature is mapped to exact source symbols and canonical owner, or has a reasoned exclusion.
Model ABI, tool schema, policy/capability, session, persistence, and service/IPC contracts are versioned and validated.
Unit, integration, negative-security, isolation, cancellation, and failure-path tests pass on the exact candidate SHA.
Evaluation report pins model/provider, prompt/config, dataset version and test run; no unsupported parity claims.
All tool side effects pass explicit policy and capability checks; privileged actions require approval where policy says so.
Run evidence includes exact commit SHA, Run ID, Job ID, Step ID, exit code and terminal logs.
Keep parent PR Draft and unmerged while any required gate is BLOCKED, residual, or unverified.
residuals: This matrix is a target specification, not proof that Aurora currently behaves like ChatGPT.
All feature-to-source-symbol mappings remain pending a complete Rust/Python/TypeScript and interface inventory.
Existing memory function catalog records are specified, not functionally verified.
No model provider, deployed inference endpoint, streaming runtime, frontend behavior, tool sandbox, or multimodal path is asserted as working.
Model training/fine-tuning is optional for the initial assistant and must not block basic integration of an existing model.
